const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl;s.canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(1,1);s.c=s.canvas.getContext('2d');s.texture=gl.createTexture();s.program=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,`#version 300 es
precision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;void main(){outColor=texture(u_image,vec2(v_uv.x,1.-v_uv.y));}`);s.mount=()=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:512px;height:512px;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(div);return div;};s.colors=['#57d8c6','#ffbc78','#ad9bff'];const mod=await ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/leaflet@1.9.4?bundle');s.L=mod.default??mod;s.div=s.mount();s.map=s.L.map(s.div,{zoomControl:false,attributionControl:false,zoomSnap:0,zoomAnimation:false,fadeAnimation:false,markerZoomAnimation:false,preferCanvas:true}).setView([37.5665,126.978],12);s.blocks=Array.from({length:30},(_,i)=>{const x=i%6,y=Math.floor(i/6),lon=126.953+x*.008,lat=37.547+y*.008;return {type:'Feature',properties:{group:(x+y)%3,height:100+((i*17)%8)*100},geometry:{type:'Polygon',coordinates:[[[lon,lat],[lon+.006,lat],[lon+.006,lat+.006],[lon,lat+.006],[lon,lat]]]}};});s.geojson={type:'FeatureCollection',features:s.blocks};s.layer=s.L.geoJSON(s.geojson,{renderer:s.L.canvas({padding:0}),style:f=>({color:'#182e3a',weight:2,fillColor:s.colors[f.properties.group],fillOpacity:.85})}).addTo(s.map);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));
